criteria.silhouette_scale: Strong large open four-spoke wheel and low bed; copper upper box overstates rear copper slab.
criteria.implementable_geometry: Cuboids and beveled forms practical; filled front corners conflict with existing layout.
criteria.mechanics_clearance: Cylinder appears coaxial with wheel shaft; must point fore-aft perpendicular to axle. Wheel-bottom support risks contact.
criteria.period_materials: Readable medium iron and restrained brass fit late nineteenth-century machinery.
criteria.family_consistency: Blue-gray planes and edge seams match refinery reference; noise should be quieter in final texture.
criteria.controls_readability: Dial pedestal readable, but front corners need clear pipe access.
criteria.gameplay_scope: No new controls; remove invented elevated copper tank to retain rear slab construction.

remaining_issues: Turn cylinder fore-aft perpendicular to left-right flywheel shaft.
Clear front corners and wheel bottom.
Reduce copper rear box to slab/utility support.
